t: The Goldscrew trade pack offers a versatile selection of high-quality multipurpose woodscrews, essential for professional carpentry and construction. This comprehensive 1400-piece assortment is ideal for various indoor timber applications, including fitting softwood frames or securing chipboard. Each carbon steel woodscrew features a deep, sharp single thread and a wax coating, ensuring a lower screw-in torque and faster driving speed without pre-drilling. The double-countersunk head reduces shear, providing a clean finish. Suitable for use with screwdrivers, combi drills, and impact drivers, these zinc-plated and yellow-passivated woodscrews deliver reliable performance for trade professionals.
b: Deep, Sharp, Single Thread for Cutting Cleanly through Wood
No Pre-Drilling Required for Quick Installation
